description:
PR #4080 shipped the 2.4 producer. Only ClickHouse server was run live (TPC-H SF0.01, system.query_log by statement ID). Unverified against real services: Snowflake (QUERY_HISTORY with the widened window), BigQuery, Databricks, Athena, Redshift (serverless sys_query_history; provisioned/unknown stl_query + stl_wlm_query, so statement IDs from pg_last_query_id may not match), Synapse, Fabric, MotherDuck. NET_ESTIMATE_CONFORMANCE is empty, so no adapter can reach net_estimate_status eligible. Redshift STL columns (queue/exec from stl_wlm_query) and the deferred-lookup path in power tests were unit-tested with fakes only.

Change. With owner approval, run TPC-H SF0.01 per adapter, check statement-ID capture, valid/suspect/unavailable status and coverage, and run the ADR conformance rule to decide eligibility. Fix defects at their cause.

Guardrails: linked worktree; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing; no live cloud without owner approval quoted in context; heavy runs through make heavy-run.
